entities.summary: Zibeyda Sadigova is an Azerbaijani human rights lawyer. For over 15 years, she has been dedicated to human rights advocacy, with a particular focus on women's rights and combating domestic violence. As a member of the Bar Association of the Republic of Azerbaijan, she has defended the rights of nearly a dozen political prisoners in the country.
